{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.40

|gr1= Mods and Addons

|descr= Returns an array of mods (CfgMods) in which the given config class is defined.

|s1= [[configSourceModList]] config

|p1= config: [[Config]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>
_mods = configSourceModList (configFile >> "CfgVehicles" >> "Man");
hint str _mods; // ["A3","curator","heli"]
</sqf>

|seealso= [[configFile]] [[configSourceMod]] [[configSourceAddonList]] [[modParams]]
}}
